acpSchema.name: agent-client-protocol-schema
acpSchema.binding: Checksum and version from the pinned Grok Cargo.lock; source inspected, never installed or executed.

limitations: The public source is a monorepo export; no verified mapping to the staged Grok 1.0.50 binary was found.
This closed turn subset omits initialize, authenticate, session creation/load, model selection and transport.
The enable-always-approve option can carry allow_once kind; only exact allow-once and reject-once pairs are selectable.
A prompt end_turn can accompany a blocked or unavailable model. It is not task or tool success evidence.
Client filesystem/terminal capabilities and rejecting reverse RPC do not disable the agent's own local backends.
Initialize can trigger settings, authentication, background synchronization and cleanup; it is not a harmless offline probe.
